newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP says Japan may face pressure on low rates-Jiji.
newsitem.headline: LDP says Japan may face pressure on low rates-Jiji.

text.p: Japan may face pressure to change its current low interest rates as it opens up its markets with its "Big Bang" deregulation measures, Jiji news agency quoted senior Japanese legislator Koichi Kato as saying on Thursday.
Kato, who is secretary-general of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), was quoted by Jiji as saying : "In the foreseeable future, Japan will have to continue its low interest rates.
"But as we undertake (economic) reforms, there will be complaints from those who are hurt by low rates, and as Big Bang opens up the markets, interest rates of a certain level will be demanded."
